To determine the optimal shutter speed at 25 frames per second (fps), we should use the 180° rule, also known as the "rule of 180". This rule states that the shutter speed should be roughly equal to the reciprocal of the frame rate to avoid camera shake and ensure a smooth image.

For 25 frames per second, you would set the shutter speed to:

1 / 25 = 1/50 seconds

So, the recommended shutter speed is 1/50 seconds. This means that the camera should be set to 1/50s shutter speed to maintain a stable image when filming at 25 frames per second.
